name: 59102 · Billings, MT
findings: ZIP 59102 (Billings) has 198 nonprofit organizations. 85 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 71 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 59102 (Billings) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 19 religious organizations here list membership, compared with about 8 in similar places of this size.
